regions.name: Tapoa
regions.title: Tapoa Province
text: Tapoa is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso. It is located in the Est Region. Its capital is Diapaga.

regions.name: Kompienga
regions.title: Kompienga Province
text: Kompienga is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Est Region.

The capital of Kompienga is Pama. The province also borders the country of Togo.  The Kompienga Dam located in the province is the country's first hydro-electric dam and is responsible for much of Ouagadougou's electricity supply.

regions.name: Léraba
regions.title: Léraba Province
text: Léraba is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Cascades Region.
Its capital is Sindou. Its highest point (and the highest point of the country) is Mount Tenakourou with an elevation of 747 metres (2,451 ft).

regions.name: Comoé
regions.title: Comoé Province
text: Comoé is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Cascades Region. The capital of Comoé is Banfora. The population of Comoé was 632,695 in 2019.

regions.name: Poni
regions.title: Poni Province
text: Poni is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sud-Ouest Region.

regions.name: Noumbiel
regions.title: Noumbiel Province
text: Noumbiel is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sud-Ouest Region. The province is the least populated province in the country.

regions.name: Oudalan
regions.title: Oudalan Province
text: Oudalan is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sahel Region.
Its capital is Gorom-Gorom. The 2019 census reported 158,146 people living in the province.

regions.name: Soum
regions.title: Djelgodji Province
text: Djelgodji (known as Soum since 2025) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sahel Region.

regions.name: Loroum
regions.title: Loroum Province
text: Loroum is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, a landlocked country in West Africa. It is located in its Nord Region with its seat at the city of Titao. As of 2019, it had a population of 198,192 inhabitants. The province experiences a tropical climate with distinct wet and dry seasons, and its economy is primarily based on agriculture.

regions.name: Yatenga
regions.title: Yatenga Province
text: Yatenga is one of the provinces of Burkina Faso, located in the Nord Region of the country. In modern Yatenga, the most prominent city is Ouahigouya (also known as Waiguya). This city served as the capital of the kingdom of Yatenga, a powerful kingdom out of the many Mossi kingdoms, but its influence decreased in the century following French colonisation. The city is famed today for being home to the Naba's (traditional kings) compound and the tomb of Naba Kango.

regions.name: Sourou
regions.title: Sourou Province
text: Sourou is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Boucle du Mouhoun.

regions.name: Kossi
regions.title: Kossin Province
text: The Province de la Kossin (known as Kossi until 2025) lies in the western part of Burkina Faso and stretches to the border with Mali. It is in the Boucle du Mouhoun Region. The capital of Kossi is the town of Nouna, which has a mayor and high commissioner. The next largest town in Kossin is Djibasso, the last major town on the road from Nouna that heads west into Mali.

In the early 2010s, a major road through the Kossin was paved with support from the Millennium Challenge Corporation. The road links the major towns of Dedougou and Nouna, then continues westward to Djibasso and the border with Mali.

regions.name: Banwa
regions.title: Banwa Province
text: Banwa is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Boucle du Mouhoun Region. The capital of Banwa is Solenzo. In 2019 it had a population of 345,749.

regions.name: Houet
regions.title: Houet Province
text: Houet is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Hauts-Bassins Region. The capital of Houet is Bobo-Dioulasso. In 2019, the province had a population of 1,509,377.

regions.name: Kénédougou
regions.title: Kénédougou Province
text: Kénédougou is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Hauts-Bassins Region. The 2019 census reported a population of 399,836.

regions.name: Séno
regions.title: Séno Province
text: Séno is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sahel Region. The name of the province comes from the Fulfulde seeno, for "sandy plain."

regions.name: Yagha
regions.title: Yagha Province
text: Yagha is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sahel Region.
In February 2020, 24 civilians were killed and three were kidnapped near a Protestant church in Pansi, Yagha Province.

regions.name: Komondjari
regions.title: Komondjari Province
text: Komondjari is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Est Region. Its capital (and only town) is Gayéri.

regions.name: Koulpélogo
regions.title: Koulpélogo Province
text: Koulpélogo is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Est Region. The population in 2019 was 361,586.

regions.name: Boulgou
regions.title: Boulgou Province
text: Boulgou is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Centre-Est Region. The capital of Boulgou is Tenkodogo. The population of Boulgou in 2019 was 737,843.

regions.name: Nahouri
regions.title: Nahouri Province
text: Nahouri (Mossi: Nawuri) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in the Centre-Sud administrative region. In 2019 the population was 195,608. Its capital is Pô.

regions.name: Sissili
regions.title: Sissili Province
text: Sissili is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Ouest Region. In 2006 the population was 212,628 and in 2011 the population was 240,830, an increase of 13.3%.

regions.name: Ioba
regions.title: Ioba Province
text: Ioba is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sud-Ouest Region. In 2019 the population was 265,876. The capital of Ioba is Dano.

regions.name: Balé
regions.title: Balé Province
text: Balé is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Boucle du Mouhoun Region with Boromo as capital. Its area is 4,596 km2 (1,775 sq mi), and had a population of 297,367 in 2019.  The province is known for its Deux Balé Forest, populated by savannah elephant herds. Boromo, the provincial capital, is located on the main road from Ouagadougou to Bobo-Dioulasso.
In June 2007, the Canadian mining company, Semafo, open the third gold mine in the country in Mana in the province, with an investment of about $116 million.

regions.name: Sanguié
regions.title: Sanguié Province
text: Sanguié is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Ouest Region. In 2019 the population was 391,520. Its capital is Réo.
Lyele is a major first language in this province.

regions.name: Tuy
regions.title: Tuy Province
text: Tuy (or Tui) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Hauts-Bassins Region. Its capital is Houndé.

regions.name: Bougouriba
regions.title: Bougouriba Province
text: Bougouriba is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Sud-Ouest Region. In 2019 the population of Bougouriba was 153,606. The capital of Bougouriba is Diébougou. The 127 km2 Bontioli Reserve is located in the province.
Bougouriba is divided into 5 departments:

regions.name: Mouhoun
regions.title: Mouhoun Province
text: Mouhoun ([mu.un], "Black Volta") is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso. It is in the Boucle du Mouhoun region. The capital of Mouhoun is Dédougou.

regions.name: Kouritenga
regions.title: Kouritenga Province
text: Kouritenga (sometimes spelt Kourittenga) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Est Region. In 2019, the province had a population of 479,930. Its capital is Koupéla.

regions.name: Ganzourgou
regions.title: Ganzourgou Province
text: Ganzourgou (Mossi: Gãnzurgu) is a province of Burkina Faso and is in Plateau-Central Region. The capital of Ganzourgou is Zorgho, which is along the road between Ouagadougou and Niamey, Niger. Other important localities  in the province are Mogtédo and Méguet. The population of Ganzourgou in 2019 was 481,794.
Ganzourgou is divided into 8 departments:

regions.name: Zoundwéogo
regions.title: Zoundwéogo Province
text: Zoundwéogo is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Sud Region. In 2019 the population of Zoundwéogo was 311,940. Its capital is Manga.

regions.name: Ziro
regions.title: Ziro Province
text: Ziro is a province of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Ouest Region. It has an area of 5,139 square kilometres (1,984 sq mi). The provincial capital is the town of Sapouy.

regions.name: Boulkiemdé
regions.title: Boulkiemdé Province
text: Boulkiemdé is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Centre-Ouest Region. The capital of Boulkiemdé is Koudougou. The population of Boulkiemdé was 498,008 in 2006 and 567,680 in 2011.

regions.name: Kadiogo
regions.title: Kadiogo Province
text: Kadiogo is a province of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre Region. Its area is of 2,805 km2, containing six departments and a population of 3,032,668 (2019). Its capital is also the state capital, Ouagadougou. It features the central plateau of the country. It is highly urbanized and is both the most populated and the most densely populated province.

regions.name: Oubritenga
regions.title: Bassitenga Province
text: Bassitegna (known as Oubritenga until 2025) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Plateau-Central Region.

regions.name: Gourma
regions.title: Gourma Province
text: Gourma is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, in Est Region. The capital of Gourma is Fada N’Gourma. The population of Gourma was 437,242 in 2019.

regions.name: Gnagna
regions.title: Gnagna Province
text: Gnagna is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, and is in Est Region. The capital of Gnagna is Bogandé.
The population of Gnagna in 2019 was 675,897.

regions.name: Bazèga
regions.title: Bazèga Province
text: Bazèga is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Centre-Sud Region. The capital of Bazèga is Kombissiri. Bazèga had a population of 238,202 in 2006, and in 2011 it was estimated to be 263,603.

regions.name: Kourwéogo
regions.title: Kourwéogo Province
text: Kourwéogo is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Plateau-Central Region. It has a population of 181,202 (2019 census).

regions.name: Nayala
regions.title: Nayala Province
text: Nayala is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Boucle du Mouhoun Region.

regions.name: Passoré
regions.title: Passoré Province
text: Passoré (French pronunciation: [pasɔʁe]) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in the Nord Region. Its capital city is Yako.

regions.name: Zondoma
regions.title: Zondoma Province
text: Zondoma is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Nord Region. In 2019 the population was 239,955. Its capital is Gourcy.

regions.name: Namentenga
regions.title: Namentenga Province
text: Namentenga is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Nord Region.

regions.name: Sanmatenga
regions.title: Sandbondtenga Province
text: Sandbondtenga (known as Sanmatenga before 2025) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Nord Region.

regions.name: Bam
regions.title: Bam Province
text: Bam is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso. It is located in Centre-Nord Region and the capital of Bam is Kongoussi. In 2019 it has a population of 473,955. It is a rural province with 420,314 of its residents living in the countryside; only 53,641 live in urban areas. There are 229,786 men living in Bam Province and 244,169 women.
